title: Bill Splitter
h1: Bill Splitter — Split a Bill Fairly Online
seoTitle: Bill Splitter — Free Online Bill Split Calculator
description: Split a restaurant or group bill including tax and tip. See each person's share instantly. Private and free, runs in your browser.
intro: Enter the total bill, number of people, optional tip percentage and tax. Instantly see how much each person owes, with a clear breakdown.
blurb: Split a group bill with tax and tip. See each person's share in seconds.
howItWorks: Enter the pre-tip bill total, how many people are splitting, and the tip and tax percentages.
Click Calculate shares. Tax is applied first, then tip is calculated on the taxed amount.
The summary shows totals and the equal share each person should pay.
examples: A $85 dinner for 3 people with 18% tip and 8% tax: each person pays roughly $34.50.
Split a $42.50 coffee-shop order among 2 people with a 10% tip and no tax.

faq.a: Yes. All numbers stay in your browser. Nothing is sent to a server.
Tax is added to the bill first, then the tip percentage is applied to that subtotal. Each person pays an equal share of the final total.
This tool splits equally. For uneven shares you can run it multiple times or calculate manually from the per-person figure.
